schema.intro: PS92 dataset of Scheduled Caste entrepreneurship loans. Every section uses full words; amounts are in rupees unless noted; percentages are per-annum interest unless stated otherwise.

top_level_sections.meta: Source, accuracy and disclaimer information plus a graph-format note.
top_level_sections.states: All State/Union Territory Scheduled Castes Development Corporations (SCDCs) we located, with full name and official website. 29 entries. Node type: State + its SCDC.
top_level_sections.schemes: The national loan schemes run by NSFDC (National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation). 7 entries. Node type: Scheme.
top_level_sections.state_schemes: State-specific schemes run by individual states on top of the national ones (often more generous). 14 entries. Node type: StateScheme. ALL entries share identical keys.
top_level_sections.channel_partner_types: The organisations that disburse NSFDC loans (State Channelizing Agencies, public sector banks, regional rural banks, etc). 8 types, 91 partners. Node type: ChannelPartner.
top_level_sections.eligibility: The rules everybody must satisfy globally (caste, income ceiling, margin money, loan-to-cost ratio).
top_level_sections.npa_thresholds: Non-Performing-Asset (bad-loan) health bands used to score a lending partner. Keys are partner types.
top_level_sections.disbursement: How much money went where - by scheme, by state, and by agency.
top_level_sections.state_scraped_rate_tables: Real numeric rate tables scraped from state SCDC websites, kept only where the page contained actual figures (not navigation menus).

states_entry.state: Full state or union territory name.
states_entry.scda_name: Full name of the development corporation.
states_entry.url: Official website where its schemes are published.
states_entry.note: Optional remark, e.g. when a corporation has no resolvable website (present only on a few entries).

schemes_entry.code: Short stable code for the scheme (e.g. MSY).
schemes_entry.name: Full scheme name.
schemes_entry.legacy_aliases: Older codes that pointed at this scheme before it was renamed/split (kept so old code keeps working).
schemes_entry.project_cost_min: Smallest qualifying project cost in rupees.
schemes_entry.project_cost_max: Largest qualifying project cost in rupees.
schemes_entry.max_loan_pct: Maximum portion of project cost NSFDC will lend (percent).
schemes_entry.rate_ca: Interest NSFDC charges the Channelizing Agent (percent).
schemes_entry.channels: Which partner types deliver this scheme.
schemes_entry.target_gender: Whether the scheme is for women only (else null).
schemes_entry.notes: Extra detail, e.g. an Education Loan has separate India and abroad rates.

state_schemes_entry.state: State or union territory running the scheme.
state_schemes_entry.name: Full scheme name.
state_schemes_entry.source: Origin of the figures (Government Order, official page).
state_schemes_entry.eligible_castes: Castes/communities that qualify (e.g. SC, ST, Other Backward Class).
state_schemes_entry.income_limit: Maximum annual family income in rupees (null if not set or varies - see notes).

funding.grant_pct: Share of the scheme given free as a grant (percent of unit cost).
funding.grant_amount_max: Cap on the grant in rupees.
funding.margin_money_pct: Share the beneficiary must bring as margin money (percent).
funding.margin_money_interest_pa: Interest on the margin money loan (percent).
funding.interest_pa_beneficiary: Single beneficiary interest rate where one applies (percent).
funding.interest_pa_men: Interest for men where it differs (percent).
funding.interest_pa_women: Interest for women where it differs (percent).

state_schemes_entry.tiers: Optional graded funding - a list of slots with different grant/contribution shares by project size (only Telangana Rajiv Yuva Vikasam uses this; empty array otherwise).
state_schemes_entry.portal: Official application portal URL (null if none).
state_schemes_entry.notes: Extra context such as helplines, sector lists, or which global scheme it overrides.

channel_partner_types_entry.count: Number of individual partners of this type.
channel_partner_types_entry.schemes: Which scheme codes this partner type delivers.
channel_partner_types_entry.partners: List of the individual partner organisations.

eligibility_rules.caste: A Scheduled Caste certificate is required.
eligibility_rules.income_max: Annual family income ceiling, raised to 5 lakh rupees from 7 Jan 2026.
eligibility_rules.entity_types: Who can apply (individual, partnership, cooperative society).
eligibility_rules.all_members_sc_required: In partnership/cooperative, every member must be Scheduled Caste.

npa_thresholds_entry.intro: For each partner type, the bank non-performing-asset percentage bands.

disbursement_entry.scheme_wise_crore: How much was lent per scheme, in crores of rupees.
disbursement_entry.state_allocation_lakh: Funds allocated per state, in lakhs of rupees.
disbursement_entry.agency_wise_crore: Funds handled per agency type, in crores.

state_scraped_rate_tables_entry.table_index: Position of the table on that page.
state_scraped_rate_tables_entry.rows: The table cells as a 2-D array.

graph_mapping.note: StateScheme codes are unique per state, so keying on (state, code) gives stable node IDs.

Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribes, 
       Other Backward Classes Minorities and Handicapped Financial and 
       Development Corporation Lt., was established by the Govt. of India in the 
       year 1993.
       The Corporation is registered as Company under the Companies Act 1956 and 
       incorporated on 12.7.1993 with Registrar of Companies, Ahmedabad having 
       authorized Share Capital of Rs 10.00 crores and paid up capital of the 
       Corporation as on date is Rs 4.43 crores. The Registered office of the 
       Corporation is situated in Silvassa and its jurisdiction is extended to 
       the whole of the Union Territory of Daman and Diu and Dadra
       and Nagar 
       Haveli.
        
       
 
       
         
           
         
         
           
           
           MESSAGE FROM 
           
           
           HON'BLE CHAIRMAN
         
         
           
           
           
             
             
               
               
               
               
               
               
               
               
               In the process of development it is necessary that all the 
               sections of the society develop in co-ordination with each other.  
               To implement this principle Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Daman & Diu   
               Scheduled
                
             
             
               
               
                Castes / Scheduled Tribe, Other 
               Backward Classes and Minorities & Handicapped Financial & 
               Development Corporation Ltd. was established to cater to the 
               needs of the people of these categories in Daman and Diu and 
               Dadra & Nagar Haveli.
               I would urge to all the people 
               belonging to these categories to take full advantage of the 
               schemes and benefits provided by the said Corporation so that 
               they can develop themselves financially and be self-reliant and 
               come up at par with other sections of the society or even excel 
               in their respective endeavours. 
               
               I wish success to the people of Daman 
               & Diu and Dadra & Nagar Haveli belonging to these categories.
               - Shri Praful Patel
             
           

           
           
           
           
         
         
           
         
         
           
           
           MESSAGE FROM
           MANAGING DIRECTOR
         
         
           
           
             
               
               
               
            
               
               
                
               
               
            
               
               
               “One may have been born Poor But by 
               Commitment & Hard Work he can reach the peak Of Development” 
               Development is a Dynamic process. It generally coincides with the 
               Economic Upliftment and Empowerment.
               
             
               
               
            
               
               
               .Corporation is committed for Both 
               i.e. Financial Assistance for Self Employment projects and 
               Empowerment Trainings. We are highly sensitive towards the needs 
               of the people we are connected with .
               “Let us move Forward”
                               
                
               
               
           
         
       
 
     
     
       
     
     
       
     
     
       
       
     
     
        
       
       
     
     
       
       
       The main objectives
     
     
       
       
     
     
       -
       
      
      To undertake the task of Economic upliftment 
      of the members of the SC/ST., Other Backward Classes, Minorities and 
      Handicapped in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Daman and 
      Diu by way of providing loan upto Rs. 15 Lakhs to Eligible applicants for 
      Self Employment / Business Development.
     
     
       
       
       
       To promote Development and provide 
       Specialized Training, Technical Education and assisting in preparing to 
       earn livelihood for the members of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes, 
       OBC, Minorities and Handicapped in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar 
       Haveli, Daman and Diu.
